title: At the Coffee Shop
description: A simple conversation ordering coffee and paying

script.speaker: A
script.text: Hi! Can I have a coffee, please?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Of course! Small, medium, or large?

script.speaker: A
script.text: Medium, please. How much is it?

script.speaker: B
script.text: It's three dollars and fifty cents.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Here you go. Can I have a receipt?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Sure! Your coffee will be ready in two minutes.

fullScript:
A: Hi! Can I have a coffee, please?
B: Of course! Small, medium, or large?
A: Medium, please. How much is it?
B: It's three dollars and fifty cents.
A: Here you go. Can I have a receipt?
B: Sure! Your coffee will be ready in two minutes.

questions.stemText: What does the man want to buy?

questions.stemText: What size does the man choose?
questions.explanation: The man says 'Medium, please.'

questions.explanation: The woman says 'It's three dollars and fifty cents.'

title: Asking for Directions

script.text: Thank you very much.

script.speaker: B
script.text: You're welcome. Have a good trip!

title: Numbers and Prices
description: A customer buys items at a market

script.speaker: A
script.text: How much are these apples?

script.speaker: B
script.text: They are two dollars for one kilogram.

script.speaker: A
script.text: I'll take two kilograms. And how much are the oranges?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Oranges are three dollars per kilogram.

script.speaker: A
script.text: OK, one kilogram of oranges too. That's seven dollars total?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Exactly right! Here's your change.

fullScript:

title: At the Doctor
description: A patient describes symptoms to a doctor

script.speaker: A
script.text: Good morning. How can I help you today?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Good morning, doctor. I have a headache and a sore throat.

script.speaker: A
script.text: Do you have a fever?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Yes, I think so. I feel very hot.

script.speaker: A
script.text: How long have you felt like this?

script.speaker: B
script.text: Since yesterday. I didn't sleep well last night.

script.speaker: A
script.text: I see. You need to rest and drink lots of water.
